export_evidence: ImportKey, slug 'unisearch-india-instruments-private-limited' (132 records, latest 2026-01-08): every visible row runs the other direction — e.g. "2026-01-08 UNISEARCH INDIA (INSTRUMENTS) PRIVATE LIMITED GLAVTEK 18 LTD AUDIT MODULE WITH A GAS CELL FOR HF GAS... CHENNAI AIR CARGO ACC INMAA4, India MOSCOW, RUSSIA 90273010 8585580" — here the company is the SUPPLIER of record on an inbound Indian import entry (origin Moscow, destination Chennai), i.e. a purchase from a Russian vendor, not an Indian export. Same pattern for 2026-01-06 (SYSCON TRADING MECHANICAL SERVICES, Bahrain, HS 90273010, BOL 8526002) and 2025-12-15 (SHANGHAI YUANQI, HS 90328990, BOL 7880997). No row shows an Indian port of loading with a foreign port of discharge. Second slug 'unisearch-india-instruments-pvt-ltd' (51 records, latest 2025-05-27) is entirely re-imports of its own exhibition goods: "RETURN EXHIBITION GOODS STACK OPTICS TX RX SPSO S B NO 9413014 DT 27 03 2025 RE IMPORT RETURN EXHIBITION GOODS INDIA Chennai Sea, India 90273010 1707813" — the shipping bill 9413014 is the outbound leg of a temporary exhibition consignment that came back, not a commercial export sale. Source counter: ImportKey claims 132 + 51 = 183 records; rows actually inspected = 10 (5 per slug, free view). No export bill of lading with a foreign consignee was seen in any inspected row.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, contract or annual-report split could be retrieved. thecompanycheck.com, eximpedia.app, volza.com and trademo.com all returned HTTP 403 to the fetch; DuckDuckGo search backend was down ("Connection refused") for the whole session, so no domestic-supply query could be run. Domestic supply is therefore not confirmed and not disproven — null, not public in the sources reachable.
note: Rule 5 applied strictly: the ImportKey 'export' framing is misleading. The 132-record slug is an IMPORT ledger (company appears as supplier on Indian inbound entries from Russia, Bahrain, China, Canada); the 51-record slug is re-import of exhibition goods under shipping bill 9413014. Neither constitutes an export shipment with a foreign buyer. So: export_status = none_found — no trace of actual outbound commercial shipments found in the reachable customs data. Domestic side is genuinely unknown, not 'declared only', because no catalogue or website claim was even reachable to record as a claim. Declared HS 902730 (spectrometers/spectrophotometers) is consistent with the goods actually seen (HS 90273010 spectrometer packages, gas-cell audit modules; also 90271000 dust monitors, 90328990 controllers) — no HS correction needed, and per project rules HS mismatch would not be a rejection ground anyway. No rejection ground exists: the entity is active in customs records as recently as 2026-01-08, so not liquidated or struck off. Revenue and export volume: null — not public in reachable sources, not estimated. Caveat on evidence quality: only 10 of 183 claimed rows were visible on free views, so a low-volume export lane cannot be fully excluded; the finding is 'no export shipment seen', not 'export proven absent'.
